fit_probe_disclosure: All error-reference coefficients use FIT24 only; both attribute heads also use FIT24. PROBE12 is repeatedly studied TRAIN, not untouched validation.
weighting: Equal cases, then supported patches, then reliable cells; no local-Lee-node exclusion.
timing: Posthoc analysis after pilot launch and before its complete scientific readout; no pilot endpoint data read or gate changed.
limitations: Both attributes and G0 error were developed on oldTRAIN; probe12 is not pristine or zero-shot.
PredictedB/error association can arise from shared CT features, not anatomical causality or useful conditional adaptation.
Balanced boundary error is local annotation-shell error, not Dice or fine-vessel benefit.
A and B error-reference fits are descriptive, distinct from the frozen nonlinear consumer and its correspondence tests.
NumPy FP64 head evaluation is not claimed bit-identical to CUDA; original head parameters remain fixed.
